item.title: ❗️ Today, during the day, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation carried out strikes

item.title: 📍 The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
item.description: The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation. 📍 The Sever Group of Forces improved its tactical situation. Russian troops inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of five mechanised brigades of the AFU and two territorial defence brigades near Malinovka, Monachinovka (Kharkov region), Brusovka, Karpovka, and Raygorodok (Donetsk People's Republic). ▪️ The AFU losses amounted to up to 210 troops, nine motor vehicles, and one field artillery gun. 📍 The Yuzhnaya Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions. The Group's elements engaged formations of four mechanised brigades, two airmobile brigades, and an assault regiment of the AFU close to Druzhkovka, Klinovoye, Kramatorsk, Nikolayevka, Orekhovatka, and Slavyansk of the Donetsk People's Republic. ▪️ Th
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/30621

The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
📍
The Sever Group of Forces improved its tactical situation.
In Kharkov region,Russian troops hit manpower and hardware of three mechanised brigades, an assault regiment of the AFU, and a territorial defence brigade close to Berezniki, Novoselovka, Ploskoye, Sadovod, and Khatneye (Kharkov region).
🔥
In Sumy region, the Group's units inflicted losses on
formations of four mechanised brigades, an airmobile brigade of the AFU, and two territorial defence brigades near Bititsa, Vakalovshchina, Krovnoye, Luzhki, Tokari, and Shtepovka of Sumy region.
▪️
The enemy lost up to 150 troops, six motor vehicles, one counter-fire radar station, and one electronic warfare station.
📍
The Zapad Group of Forces improved the situation along the front line.
Russian troops inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of five mechanised brigades of the AFU and two territorial defence brigades near Malinovka, Monachinovka (Kharkov region), Brusovka, Karpovka, and Raygorodok (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to up to 210 troops, nine motor vehicles, and one field artillery gun.
📍
The Yuzhnaya Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions.
The Group's elements engaged formations of four mechanised brigades, two airmobile brigades, and an assault regiment of the AFU close to Druzhkovka, Klinovoye, Kramatorsk, Nikolayevka, Orekhovatka, and Slavyansk of the Donetsk People's Republic.
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to more than 180 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, 26 motor vehicles, one field artillery gun, and four electronic warfare stations.
↗️
Units of the Tsentr Group of Forces continue to carry out intensive offensive operations.
Losses were inflicted on manpower and hardware of a mechanised brigade, an airborne brigade, an assault brigade, an assault regiment of the AFU, three marine brigades, the Azov special operations brigade, and four national guard brigades close to Verovka, Golubovka, Mikhaylovka, Novodonetskoye, Novopavlovka, Sergeyevka, Starorayskoye, Uritskoye, and Yakovlevka of the Donetsk People's Republic.
▪️
Up to 350 troops, six armoured fighting vehicles, two motor vehicles, and three electronic warfare stations were neutralised.
👉
See
Part 2
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ❗️ Last night, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continued to launch strikes by unmanned aerial vehicles against energy facilities, port and railway infrastructure, as wel
item.description: ❗️ Last night, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continued to launch strikes by unmanned aerial vehicles against energy facilities, port and railway infrastructure, as well as vessels used in the interests of providing support to the AFU. 💥 As a result of the strike, the following targets were hit: ▫️ a power substation in Velikiye Mezhirichi (Rovno region), which operates logistics centres used by the AFU to store military equipment; ▫️ a ferry terminal, a port control station, and a power substation i n the Chernomorsk port of Odessa region, which ensure the unloading and storage of military cargo delivered to Ukraine; ▫️ a dry cargo ship delivering military and dual-use goods to the AFU to the port of Odessa during a sea passage. 🔥 In addition, two railway locomotives were hit close to Dnepropetrovsk station, which are used to transport goods used to support the AFU. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 📑 Across waves of Caspian Sea under St. Andrew’s flag More than three centuries ago, on 15 November 1722, Peter I founded the Caspian Flotilla to protect the southern borders.
item.description: Across waves of Caspian Sea under St. Andrew’s flag 📑 More than three centuries ago, on 15 November 1722, Peter I founded the Caspian Flotilla to protect the southern borders. Today, its modern ships and marines continue the traditions of their ancestors, fighting with honour in the most dangerous areas in the special military operation zone. 💬 Commander-in-Chief of the Russian Navy Admiral of the Fleet Aleksandr Moiseyev congratulated the sailors of the Caspian Flotilla and noted that the sailors and marines of the Caspian Flotilla are an example of valiant service to the Fatherland during the special military operation, and they demonstrate bravery, courage, fortitude and self‑sacrifice in fierce battles. Congrats, Caspian sailors! ▫️ 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/30616

Today, its modern ships and marines continue the traditions of their ancestors, fighting with honour in the most dangerous areas in the special military operation zone.
💬

and noted that the sailors and marines of the Caspian Flotilla are an example of valiant service to the Fatherland during the special military operation, and they demonstrate bravery, courage, fortitude and self‑sacrifice in fierce battles.
Congrats, Caspian sailors!
